llm_response.reason: The site exhibits numerous scam indicators: urgency tactics ('Get Started in 30 Seconds'), psychological appeals to profit, claims to legitimacy by mimicking the names and branding of real companies (Bybit, Bitget), vague or non-existent privacy/company info, unexplained references to certificates, very recent and privacy-shielded domain registration, non-standard customer support links, and promises of effortlessly increasing profits. These meet the listed scam criteria typical for cryptocurrency scams.
